crockpot.title: Crock-Pot 3850 (2 1/2 quart) instruction manual, page 8: Guide to Adapting Recipes
quotes: Most uncooked meat and vegetables combinations will requiere at least 8 hours on LOW
EXCEPTION: milk, sour cream or cream should be added during last hour.
Do not add as much water as some recipes indicate.
Remember - liquids don't "boil away" as in conventional cooking.
crockpot.note: Chart mixes English and Spanish units (minutos, horas); 50 minutes to 3 hours = 50-180 min.

fsis.title: Slow Cookers and Food Safety
quotes: Always thaw meat or poultry before putting it into a slow cooker.
Fill cooker no less than half full and no more than two-thirds full.
Vegetables cook slower than meat and poultry in a slow cooker so if using them, put the vegetables in first.
Keep the lid in place, removing only to stir the food or check for doneness.
